title: UX Source False-Friend Gate: licensed bycatch stops counting as proof

ciFast.note: Fast verification is claimed only after v0.15.114 is pushed and the GitHub Actions run is attached.

deploy.note: Pages deploy is not claimed until the pushed v0.15.114 release completes its deploy run.

ciDeep.note: This is a narrow source-relevance truth release; focused source-ledger tests plus normal gates are the release bar.

liveProvider.note: The release is based on a fresh deployed v0.15.113 ZIP/log audit plus a patched local regrade. A fresh deployed v0.15.114 audit is still required before claiming strict-clean provider output.

manualHuman.note: No external instructor approval is claimed by this release.

claims.summary: A fresh deployed v0.15.113 UX audit exported Quality 99 and Texture 90 with no embedded P findings, but patched source audit exposed trusted sourceLedger rows that were licensed and concept-linked but off-discipline.
UX source-finder and source-ledger export reject family-mediation, behavior-therapy, MTA-accessibility, and Design Research store bycatch while preserving discipline-matched UX rows.
The deep quality grader flags the captured v0.15.113 false-friend source rows as P1 citation findings, so the package no longer reads as source-clean under current rules.
Focused regressions pin both production source-ledger filtering and local grader behavior for the exact v0.15.113 false-friend class.
The release explicitly carries forward Texture 90, generic lesson identity, and fresh deployed v0.15.114 provider verification instead of claiming strict-clean output.

knownRemainingTargets: Fresh deployed v0.15.114 ZIP/log audit must prove the false-friend rows stay out of trusted sourceLedger proof.
The v0.15.113 fresh audit measured Texture 90/100, so deterministic texture variation remains below the strict target.
The same v0.15.113 audit showed generic lesson identity such as project-based undergraduate course in Course Map and filenames.
Genome linkage remains 0/12 in the v0.15.113 evidence and needs source/research bridge work before strict-clean can be claimed.
